description: Redevelopment of the site involving substantial demolition of existing buildings and structures, and partial retention of the façade of the unlisted building of merit, to be incorporated within a new commercial building comprising basement, ground and nine upper floors. The development would provide commercial floorspace, including a flexible commercial unit (Use Classes E(a), E(b) and E(g)(i)) and café (Class E(b)) at ground floor level, office accommodation (Class E(g)(i)) on the upper floors, and cycle parking, end-of-trip facilities and plant at basement level. The proposals also include external terraces, public realm and highway works, and other associated works.
site_name: 1, One Chapel Place, One Chapel Place, London, W1G 0DJ
